#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One-time macOS setup for working on ZeroDrop with Claude Code, Entire and Neatlogs.
# Run from the repo root: bash scripts/mac_setup.sh
# Keys are typed at hidden prompts and written only to the git-ignored .env (mode 600).
# They are never echoed, never passed on a command line and never put into a Claude prompt.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
say() { printf '\n==> %s\n' "$1"; }

say "Homebrew packages (uv, node, gh, gitleaks, jq, Entire CLI)"
if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
  eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv 2>/dev/null || /usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
fi
brew install uv node gh gitleaks jq
brew install --cask entireio/tap/entire || echo "Entire cask failed; see https://entire.io for the installer"

say "Claude Code"
command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

say "Claude Code plugins and skills"
claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official || true
for p in superpowers context7 playwright frontend-design pyright-lsp; do
  claude plugin install "$p@claude-plugins-official" || echo "plugin $p: install manually with /plugin"
done
for s in neatlogs-py neatlogs-py-openai neatlogs-public-api-cli; do
  npx -y skills add neatlogs/skills --skill "$s" -y || echo "skill $s: install manually"
done

say "Python and UI dependencies"
uv sync
(cd ui && npm ci && npm run build)

say "Runtime keys -> .env (hidden input or a macOS dialog; empty keeps the current value)"
touch .env && chmod 600 .env
set_key() {
  local name="$1" value
  if grep -q "^${name}=." .env; then echo "$name already set"; return 0; fi
  if [ -t 0 ]; then
    printf '%s: ' "$name"
    read -rs value; printf '\n'
  else
    # No terminal (run by Claude Code): ask in a macOS dialog so the value never reaches the transcript.
    value=$(osascript -e "text returned of (display dialog \"Paste ${name} (hidden; saved only to .env)\" default answer \"\" with hidden answer with title \"ZeroDrop setup\")" 2>/dev/null) || value=""
  fi
  [ -z "$value" ] && return 0
  grep -v "^${name}=" .env > .env.tmp || true
  printf '%s=%s\n' "$name" "$value" >> .env.tmp
  mv .env.tmp .env && chmod 600 .env
}
set_key ZERODROP_ANTHROPIC_KEY
set_key NEATLOGS_API_KEY
git check-ignore -q .env && echo ".env is git-ignored: OK"

say "Secret scan hook (gitleaks on every commit)"
if [ ! -f .git/hooks/pre-commit ] || ! grep -q gitleaks .git/hooks/pre-commit; then
  printf '#!/bin/sh\ngitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner\n' >> .git/hooks/pre-commit
  chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
fi

say "Entire: log in and install the checkpoint hooks"
entire login || echo "run 'entire login' again later"
entire enable --agent claude-code --telemetry=false || true
entire status || true

say "Checks"
uv run pytest -q | tail -3
uv run ruff check .
set -a; . ./.env; set +a
uv run python -m neatlogs doctor --local || true

say "Done. Next: run 'claude' in this folder and paste the prompt from docs/MAC_KICKOFF.md"

"""Neatlogs integration: initialise once per process, no-op when no key is configured.

Every module traces through this file so the SDK is imported and initialised in
exactly one place. `init_telemetry()` must run before `anthropic` is imported
anywhere (the CLI and API entry points call it first).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import functools
import os
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from typing import Any, TypeVar

F = TypeVar("F", bound=Callable[..., Any])

_enabled = False


def init_telemetry(workflow_name: str = "zerodrop-migration", tags: list[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    """Initialise Neatlogs if NEATLOGS_API_KEY is set. Returns True when tracing is active."""
    global _enabled
    if _enabled:
        return True
    api_key = os.getenv("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        return False
    import neatlogs

    neatlogs.init(api_key=api_key, workflow_name=workflow_name, tags=tags or [])
    _enabled = True
    return True


def enabled() -> bool:
    return _enabled


def wrap_client(client: Any) -> Any:
    """Wrap an Anthropic client so every model call becomes an LLM span (no manual LLM spans elsewhere)."""
    if not _enabled:
        return client
    import neatlogs

    return neatlogs.wrap(client)


def span(kind: str, name: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Callable[[F], F]:
    """Decorator: a Neatlogs span when tracing is active, otherwise the function unchanged.

    The check happens at call time so modules can be imported before init_telemetry().
    """

    def decorator(fn: F) -> F:
        traced: Callable[..., Any] | None = None

        @functools.wraps(fn)
        def wrapper(*args: Any, **kw: Any) -> Any:
            nonlocal traced
            if not _enabled:
                return fn(*args, **kw)
            if traced is None:
                import neatlogs

                traced = neatlogs.span(kind=kind, name=name or fn.__name__, **kwargs)(fn)
            return traced(*args, **kw)

        return wrapper  # type: ignore[return-value]

    return decorator


@contextlib.contextmanager
def trace(name: str, kind: str = "TOOL", **attributes: Any) -> Iterator[Any]:
    """Context manager span; yields the span (or None when tracing is off)."""
    if not _enabled:
        yield None
        return
    import neatlogs

    with neatlogs.trace(name, kind=kind, **attributes) as s:
        yield s


def set_attr(span_obj: Any, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
    if span_obj is None:
        return
    with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
        span_obj.set_attribute(key, value)


def log(message: str, level: str = "info", **data: Any) -> None:
    if not _enabled:
        return
    import neatlogs

    with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
        neatlogs.log(message, level=level, **data)


def shutdown() -> None:
    global _enabled
    if not _enabled:
        return
    import neatlogs

    neatlogs.flush()
    neatlogs.shutdown()
    _enabled = False

SUPPORTED_MODEL_PREFIXES: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "claude-opus-5",
    "claude-sonnet-5",
    "claude-fable-5",
    "claude-haiku-5",
)


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8", extra="ignore")

    # Model access: a dedicated variable so Claude Code never picks it up as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
    zerodrop_anthropic_key: SecretStr | None = None
    model: str = "claude-opus-5-5"  # validated: must start with one of SUPPORTED_MODEL_PREFIXES
    effort_plan: str = "medium"  # mapping and diagnosis
    effort_light: str = "low"  # small classification-style calls

    # Hard limits per run.
    max_llm_calls: int = 30
    max_cost_usd: float = 1.50
    max_wall_seconds: int = 900
    max_replans: int = 3
    max_attempts_per_request: int = 6
    # 429 + Retry-After means "wait", not "broken": counted separately (the wall-clock cap still applies).
    max_rate_limit_waits: int = 40

    # Endpoints.
    source_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8701"
    target_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8702"
    target_token: SecretStr = SecretStr("nb_live_local_demo_token")
    target_token_file: str | None = None  # rotated credentials are re-read from here once on 401

    # Engine.
    batch_size: int = 50
    http_timeout_s: float = 2.0
    db_path: str = "zerodrop.db"

    # Neatlogs reads NEATLOGS_API_KEY itself; listed here only for documentation.
    neatlogs_api_key: SecretStr | None = Field(default=None, repr=False)

    @field_validator("model")
    @classmethod
    def _supported_model(cls, value: str) -> str:
        model = value.strip()
        if not model.startswith(SUPPORTED_MODEL_PREFIXES):
            allowed = ", ".join(f"{prefix}*" for prefix in SUPPORTED_MODEL_PREFIXES)
            raise ValueError(
                f"unsupported model {value!r}: ZeroDrop always sends adaptive thinking and an effort "
                f"level, which older models reject; use a model id starting with one of {allowed} "
                "(default claude-opus-5-5)"
            )
        return model


def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()
